plain_gap_note_cn: 这 84.0% 与第 1 节的 96.5% 之间的差不是模型变了，是题的分布变了：这 160 条只覆盖电池 / 过热 / 磁盘三个场景，其中 26 条磁盘工单的短记录故意不提备份（短记录规则的标签是 3，模型没有依据只能答 1–2，26 道全错），去掉这 26 道是 88.1%；过热场景的队列题（`remote_l1`）本来就是 C 最弱的一类，在原测试集同三个场景上 C 是 93.2%（109/117）。所以“规则文本写法变了”这一层是 84.0% → 63.1%：训练时每道题的 `instructions` 是固定的，模型把它当格式标记而不是当规则读，追加三句条款就把紧急度题从 83.1% 打到 73.1%、队列题从 73.1% 打到 36.9%——这和第 2 节“规则跟随”里“改规则文本它不跟”的结论是同一件事。
plain_gap_note_en: The gap between this 84.0% and section 1's 96.5% is not the model but the question mix: these 160 records cover only the battery / overheating / disk scenarios, and the short records of the 26 disk tickets deliberately omit the backup status (the short-record policy label is 3, the model has nothing to go on and answers 1–2, all 26 wrong); without those 26 it is 88.1%, and the overheating queue question (`remote_l1`) was already C's weakest class — on the same three scenarios of the original test set C scores 93.2% (109/117). So the "rule text changed" layer is 84.0% → 63.1%: during training each question's `instructions` were fixed, the model treats them as a format marker rather than a rule to read, and appending three clauses knocks the urgency question from 83.1% to 73.1% and the queue question from 73.1% to 36.9% — the same finding as "it does not follow a changed rule text" in section 2's rule-following test.
